name: iLovePDF
summary: Online PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, OCR and redact PDFs in the browser.
description: A suite of browser tools for PDF work: merge, split, compress, convert to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, HTML and Markdown, plus edit, sign, watermark, protect, OCR, repair, compare and redact. Free use processes a limited number of documents; Premium removes the limits and adds desktop and mobile apps, AI credits and a builder that chains tools into reusable workflows.
contains: 30+ tools: merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, watermark, OCR, redact, repair, compare
workflow builder chains tools into reusable workflows
web, desktop and mobile apps; iLoveAPI for automation
16.5 million documents processed every day (site claim)
free tier with limited processing; Premium from $4/month/user (annual billing)
AI features: summarizer, PDF translation, PDF to Markdown
